key_insight: Evolve on Graph (EoG) improves LLM multi-hop knowledge-graph reasoning through self-play without requiring question–answer annotations.
engineering_relevance: EoG offers a way to train graph-reasoning agents for annotation-scarce domains such as finance and industry using an existing knowledge graph.
method: A single LLM alternates between a Proposer that generates questions and a Solver that answers them.
Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis executes first-order logic queries to produce reasoning skeletons with correct, complete answer sets.
A boundary-aware curriculum rewards Solver score variance to adapt question topologies to the Solver’s evolving capabilities.
evidence_signal: Across six benchmarks covering Freebase, Wikidata, and an industrial knowledge graph, EoG consistently outperforms prompting-, retrieval-, and agent-based methods, according to the abstract.
watch_item: Practical deployment depends on reliable symbolic query execution; answers verified against a knowledge graph may still reflect gaps or errors in that graph.
paper_title: Evolve on Graph: Self-Evolving Knowledge Graph Reasoning without Question Annotations
